what_happened.line: The Select Board moved to revoke J&M Sports Bar's liquor license effective Friday, June 15, after a violation hearing.
In a joint meeting with the Finance Committee, the board reviewed ten-year fire (paramedic) and police staffing plans and taxing to the levy limit; no policy was decided.
The police chief said the staffing ask is for this year, repeated over ten years; the public safety coordinator gave the ten-year total for adding one officer a year.
The board voted to extend the Bootleggers alcohol license extension another 90 days and to ratify a reserve police officer appointment.
The board authorized the chair to sign a letter of support for a Section 319 grant application, then approved its committee appointments.

why_it_matters: The staffing plans, if adopted later, would add recurring public safety costs to the town budget, mostly taxes, and the levy-limit discussion bears on how much of that tax room is used.
The license revocation ends alcohol sales at one local business unless the decision is changed.
watch_next: Next week's meeting is to focus on goal setting, and the board is considering skipping its July 3 meeting.
Planning Board session on recreational marijuana on June 25.
